thread:
alex_cs: Heads-up — Hearthly renewal flagged for next month. Usage down ~40% over last 30d, onboarding still at 60% completed. Can we put together a 7-day micro-save plan + a downgrade-safe path? Need quick wins and who owns enablement.
jeni_csm: on it. quick Q: are they on dedicated seats or usage-based? that changes the financial ask.
mike_pm: looks like usage-based. I pulled the billing preview, estimate at-risk ~$8k MRR. if they downgrade it's a $4k delta.
sam_support: I can run a config sweep and check any error spikes that could be blocking onboarding. scheduling now.
ramon_enable: I can do a 30-min runbook session with their admins this week. best slots: wed/thu morning PT. want me to propose times?
alex_cs: yes plz @ramon_enable. let's prioritize a product walkthrough + a tailored prompt/embedding checklist for their integration.
jeni_csm: draft of micro-save play (rough):
```
Day 0: 30m health check + quick config fixes (sam_support)
Day 1: 30m enablement session for power users (ramon_enable)
Day 2-4: proactive outreach + 1:1 walkthroughs for stalled users (CS)
Day 5: ROI summary + low-friction pilot feature activation (PM)
Day 6: renewal offer + downgrade-safe path communicated
```
Note: keep all asks <20 mins and surface product wins.
mike_pm: low-friction pilot = enable 'smart-templates' + sampling of embeddings caching. we can flip a flag from backend for them now — reduces token costs and improves latency, easy win.
alex_cs: downgrade-safe path (short): offer 25% discounted usage cap for 3 months OR move to restricted feature set with pricing at 60% of current spend. include clear re-upgrade flow and data export assurances.
sam_support: found 2 onboarding steps failing for new API keys (timeout on token exchange). patching config and will follow up in 15m. will post logs if anything else shows.
ops_bot: reminder set: "Hearthly micro-save 7-day plan" scheduled for 2026-04-01T15:00:00Z. Assigned: alex_cs, jeni_csm, ramon_enable, sam_support, mike_pm.
jeni_csm: I'll prepare a 1-page win summary + 3-user case studies to share on Day 5. also adding feedback capture form to record objections and product gaps.
alex_cs: perfect. next steps — ramon confirm times, sam confirm fix, jeni draft summary, mike enable pilot flag. I'll update the renewal owner and escalate if patch not verified by EOD.
ramon_enable: wed 10:30 PT confirmed. sending calendar invites to Hearthly admins and tagging CS leads.
sam_support: config fix verified at 1769876565, onboarding success rate jumped +18% for new keys. sharing logs in the thread.
alex_cs: beautiful. capturing feedback: have 3 discrete asks from customer — (1) cheaper small-batch plan, (2) clearer setup docs for API keys, (3) example templates for their domain. we'll feed to PM + docs. thanks team :rocket:
